posts.text: Hyperfocus: where I become a genius for 6 hours and then a potato for 3 days.
ADHD means my brain refuses to work until it’s 3 minutes before a deadline.
Reminder: → Showing up when you’ve got the energy
You’re not lazy. You’re trying to sprint through mental quicksand. Systems > shame.
ADHD hack turns simple tasks into side quests so I built tools that work with it, not against it.
Getting diagnosed late doesn’t mean you’re behind—it means you finally have tools.
